svg.aria-label: Isometric detection pipeline: the Cisco network, OPNsense and Suricata, the Windows domain, Proxmox and Docker, and UniFi stream logs into a Wazuh core that decodes, correlates and responds, then forwards events to a Splunk data store with dashboards. A brute force on SWAGGER-DC-01 is caught, Wazuh raises a level 10 alert and sends an active response back to block the source.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
